children: Anthropic PBC, the company behind the Claude chatbot, is reportedly contemplating the release of a new AI model prior to its anticipated initial public offering (IPO), according to sources cited by Reuters. This development comes as Anthropic races to compete with OpenAI following the launch of GPT-6 Astra. The company's IPO marketing is expected to begin in mid-October, though the exact timing has shifted later than initially planned. The potential release of a new AI model could be a strategic move to bolster investor confidence and enhance the company's valuation ahead of its public debut.

In the current prediction markets, the possibility of Anthropic achieving a market cap exceeding $1.25 trillion at its IPO close is priced at varied probabilities across different sub-markets. A notable shift has been observed in the market segment projecting a market cap between $2.0 trillion and $2.25 trillion, where the probability has increased to 24.8% from 23% a day earlier. This suggests that market participants may view the potential AI model release as a factor likely to boost Anthropic's valuation prospects.

The anticipation surrounding Anthropic's IPO is further reflected in the prediction markets focused on the timing of the IPO itself. With a high probability of 79% that the IPO will occur by December 31, 2026, market sentiment appears consistent with confidence in Anthropic's readiness to proceed with its public listing within the year.
Market activity suggests support for scenarios where Anthropic's market cap exceeds $1.25 trillion at IPO close, especially in light of new AI developments.
The probability of Anthropic's IPO occurring by the end of 2026 remains high, with a 79% YES likelihood currently priced in.
Participants appear to interpret the potential AI model release as a strategic move to strengthen Anthropic's competitive position and valuation.

Observers will be keenly watching for any official announcements from Anthropic regarding the release of the new AI model, as well as any updates on the IPO timeline. Additionally, any disclosures related to AI revenue or annual recurring revenue (ARR) could significantly impact market sentiment and pricing. Developments in the broader AI industry, including competitor activities and regulatory changes, will also be crucial in shaping the outlook for Anthropic's market debut.
